title: Eui-Am

symbol.name: Eui-Am
symbol.meaning: The independence leader Son Byong-hi · ITF pattern 13 of 24

note.p: Eui-Am is the pen name of Son Byong-hi, leader of the Korean independence movement of 1 March 1919. The 45 movements stand for his age in 1905, when he renamed Dong Hak (Eastern learning) as Chondo Kyo (the Heavenly Way religion). The diagram, a single line, stands for his indomitable spirit in the service of his country. The pattern stays on the C–D line, starting in close ready stance D at its centre facing D: knife-hand inward and outer forearm blocks, a twisting kick, an X-fist block and a jump into X-stance; a reverse turning kick, a side kick and crescent and turning punches; the same toward C; then knife-hand wedging blocks, reverse knife-hand circular blocks and alternate palm blocks; two high reverse turning kicks; and low knife-hand blocks with punches to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (45 movements, one technique each). The whole pattern is on the C–D line, so the board shows the moves in order, read down the page in rows along the centre line; the minimap shows roughly where each count is on the line. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; AD, AC, BD and BC are the diagonals. Finish by bringing the right foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the C–D line facing D in close ready stance D: feet together, the hands together in front of the body.
Move the right foot to C into a left walking stance facing D. Right knife-hand low inward block.
Move the left foot to C into a right walking stance facing D. Left outer forearm high side block.
In the same stance, right middle punch.
Left low twisting kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot toward D into a left walking stance. X-fist downward block.
In the same stance, right knife-hand rising block, flowing on from 5.
Jump toward D, landing in a right X-stance facing BD. Right back fist high side strike toward D, the left fingertips on the right side fist.
Move the left foot to C into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left middle side punch toward C.
Right middle reverse turning kick toward AC.
Stamp the right foot down toward C into a sitting stance facing A. Right knife-hand middle side strike toward C.
Turning clockwise, left middle side piercing kick toward C, pulling both hands apart.
Lower the left foot toward C into a left walking stance facing C. Right high crescent punch.
Pull the right foot up into a parallel stance facing C. Left middle turning punch, slowly.
Move the left foot to D into a right walking stance facing C. Left knife-hand low inward block.
Move the right foot to D into a left walking stance facing C. Right outer forearm high side block.
In the same stance, left middle punch.
Right low twisting kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot toward C into a right walking stance. X-fist downward block.
In the same stance, left knife-hand rising block, flowing on from 18.
Jump toward C, landing in a left X-stance facing BC. Left back fist high side strike toward C, the right fingertips on the left side fist.
Move the right foot to D into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right middle side punch toward D.
Left middle reverse turning kick toward AD.
Stamp the left foot down toward D into a sitting stance facing A. Left knife-hand middle side strike toward D.
Turning counter-clockwise, right middle side piercing kick toward D, pulling both hands apart.
Lower the right foot toward D into a right walking stance facing D. Left high crescent punch.
Pull the left foot up into a parallel stance facing D. Right middle turning punch, slowly.
Move the right foot to D into a right walking stance facing D. Knife-hand middle wedging block.
In the same stance, left reverse knife-hand circular block toward BD.
Pull the right foot back into a left rear foot stance facing D (right foot forward). Alternate palm downward block.
Slip the right foot forward into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Left middle punch.
Shift back toward C, keeping the L-stance. Right reverse knife-hand low inward block.
Move the left foot to D into a left walking stance facing D. Knife-hand middle wedging block.
In the same stance, right reverse knife-hand circular block toward AD.
Pull the left foot back into a right rear foot stance facing D (left foot forward). Alternate palm downward block.
Slip the left foot forward into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right middle punch.
Shift back toward C, keeping the L-stance. Left reverse knife-hand low inward block.
Right high reverse turning kick toward BD.
Lower the right foot toward D into a left rear foot stance facing D (right foot forward on its ball). Forearm middle guarding block.
Left high reverse turning kick toward AD.
Lower the left foot toward D into a right rear foot stance facing D (left foot forward on its ball). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the left foot to the side rear of the right foot, then the right foot to C, into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left knife-hand low outward block.
Slip the right foot into a left walking stance facing D. Right middle punch.
Move the left foot to C into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right knife-hand low block.
Slip the left foot into a right walking stance facing D. Left middle punch.
In the same stance, right high punch.
